text: うーん…　もうすこし　すごいことに　なったら　またきてよー

structure.jp: もうすこし　すごいことに　なったら
structure.en: when things get a bit more impressive

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'when' or 'if' that thing has happened. なったら = 'when it becomes so'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.span: すごいことに　なったら
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what something turns into. すごいことに なったら = 'when it becomes something amazing'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A て-form left at the end of a sentence is a casual way to ask someone to do something. きてよー = 'come, okay?'.
